_comment: Single source of truth for the values quoted on /docs/design-system/. Read by the swatch and token-table shortcodes. Every value here was read out of the theme (assets/css/main.css, tailwind.preset.js, layouts/partials/*) rather than transcribed from the design reference — where the two disagreed, the repo won.

color.name: brand
color.usage: Logo word 1, nav links, article meta icons, blockquote rule

color.name: accent
color.usage: Aside icons, tag chips, tag cloud, CTA hover

color.name: chrome-from
color.usage: Declared only — nothing in the theme reads it

color.name: chrome-to
color.usage: Declared only — nothing in the theme reads it

untokenized.name: Surfaces
untokenized.why: Page and panel backgrounds. Repointing these is choosing a different theme, not configuring this one.

untokenized.name: Structural greys
untokenized.why: Meta labels and card borders. Neutral scaffolding, not brand.

untokenized.name: Alert hues
untokenized.why: Semantic. Yellow means warning; routing it through a brand token would destroy the meaning.

untokenized.name: Platform fills
untokenized.why: They match the platforms they link to. Not Ryder's colours to change.

radius.name: rounded-md
radius.where: Nav links, TOC links, footer submenu

radius.name: rounded-lg
radius.where: Header inner frame, alerts, nav list, share buttons, form fields

radius.name: rounded-xl
radius.where: Cards, article header shell, aside panels, table wrapper, empty state

radius.name: rounded-full
radius.where: CTAs, tag cloud chips, social icons, hamburger, theme toggle

shadow.name: shadow-sm
shadow.where: Card at rest, article header shell, aside panels, share buttons

shadow.name: shadow-md
shadow.where: Card on hover — transition-shadow duration-200 ease-in-out
